description: Drops the stored connection between this chat and the host's WordPress site, and also forgets that this site was ever connected (so a later chat does not offer it again). Material loss / hard to reverse: the connection has to be approved again in the host's own browser before anything else can run. The site itself stays untouched. Needs `session_id`. It ends only the connection of THIS app; other apps the host connected stay signed in. Pass `all: true` only when the host said they want every app disconnected.

all.description: Only after the host said so: end every connection of this host, in all apps, not just this one.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_disconnect_wordpress
title: Disconnect the WordPress site
